Admins can now change a user's role from a select in each row of the users table. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been run or type-checked.

- **API (`features/users/api/update-user-role.ts`):**
  - `updateUserRole` sends `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` with `{ role }`.
  - `useUpdateUserRole` invalidates the `['users']` query so the list shows the new role.
  - The same hook shows the "User Role Updated" success notification. I put it in the hook rather than the component because `features/CLAUDE.md` requires success notifications there.
- **Component (`features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx`):** a native select with ADMIN and USER options. It's disabled while a change is saving and on your own row, so an admin can't demote themselves.
- **Users table (`users-list.tsx`):** the Role column now renders this select instead of plain text.
- **Mock API (`testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`):** I added an MSW handler for the new endpoint. It requires an admin and only updates users in the same team.

I used a plain `<select>` because the shared `Select` component only works with react-hook-form registration. It would have needed a wrapper for a single-field change.

I didn't add a test for the new endpoint.
